profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company traded on NASDAQ under the ticker EH, headquartered in Guangzhou. On its own site the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions to customers across several industries, listing urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management and aerial media solutions. The company describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry. Sections of its site also point to emergency rescue and infrastructure solutions alongside passenger transportation, logistics and aerial media.

The site presents the company's focus as urban air mobility and the commercial application of autonomous aircraft rather than AI software as such. No specific AI products, model names or research programs appear in the material available, and the company's claims about its market position are its own characterizations rather than figures. No lawsuits, no tracked products and no MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001759783 and identify it as a for-profit public company.
